name: post_close_end_stream_double_stop
comment: review F5 Sec 8.9: close{} answers s1 closed and emits ProducerStop{closed}; a LATER end_stream{s1} still transitions reader-count >=1->0 (the stream entry is not removed by close) and emits a SECOND ProducerStop{last_reader_gone} -- ProducerStop is idempotent by design (D6), so this double-stop is intentional and cross-engine-consistent, previously unpinned
